tool_config.name: bodyshop_resolve_confirmed_intake
tool_config.description: Call only after the operator has confirmed the complete BODYSHOP breakdown read-back. Send only confirmed values. If any required value is missing or uncertain, ask for clarification instead of calling this tool. The tool returns a BODYSHOP-owned canonical resolution or a fail-closed clarification result and never creates or mutates an operational breakdown.

parameters.description: Operator-confirmed breakdown intake. Do not invent, infer, or silently normalize missing operational values.

workshop.description: Confirmed BODYSHOP workshop scope, code or canonical spoken value.

installation.description: Confirmed installation or local production area.

device.description: Confirmed affected physical device or element.

subdevice.description: Confirmed affected subdevice when applicable. Omit when no subdevice is applicable or known.

description.description: Confirmed observable symptom or breakdown description. A root-cause diagnosis is not required.

line_stopped.description: Confirmed answer to whether the production line is stopped.
